verdict.rationale: Devin's docs explicitly support tackling Jira and Linear tickets, and its MCP framework generically allows connecting 'issue trackers' as external tool servers, which could extend to ClickUp/Monday.com via custom MCP servers. However, there is no documented native/first-party connector for ClickUp or Monday.com, and no evidence of built-in ticket-management workflows (create/update/assign) beyond referencing tickets as tasks.  missing for 10: native ClickUp/Monday.com integrations, evidence of two-way ticket management (creating/updating tickets, not just referencing them), independent confirmation of MCP-based issue-tracker setups in practice.
